primitives.verbatim_quote: # Contributing We use GitHub Issues as the primary public feedback channel.
primitives.assumptions: Public feedback is modeled as a discrete event stream with bounded cardinality.

primitives.name: Dependency Control Kernel

primitives.assumptions: Dependency versions are constrained to prevent semantic drift in runtime behavior.
